normalization_rules.authority: Origin official documentation governs official offering; serving-provider catalog governs that serving offering. Different endpoint limits/prices are retained rather than blindly overriding.
normalization_rules.dates: Catalog-created timestamp is not assumed to be model release date.
normalization_rules.identity: catalog_id is an offering/catalog identity; canonical_slug is source declared, not global deduplication proof. Do not merge aliases/quantizations/free/batch variants by string similarity.
normalization_rules.license: HF identifier alone is not proof of open weights or license.
normalization_rules.null: Unknown, unreported, or not independently established. Never coerce absent supported parameter to false.
normalization_rules.units: Integer token limits when exact; abbreviated official limits retained as display strings without guessing K=1000 or 1024. USD token prices per one million tokens. Other billing units remain in raw.

scope.availability_definition: listed/documented means discoverable; no authenticated inference tests performed.
scope.common_candidate_rule: First five returned catalog records per selected mainstream author, plus official-only additions; heuristic, not measured popularity.
coverage_gaps: Models absent from OpenRouter and unvisited official catalogs
